outcome.technical: (1) ci.yml concurrency comment and CHANGELOG line reworded (reword option taken, group not re-keyed): a running main run is never cancelled, a run queued behind it is replaced by a newer push. (2) gate-parity.py: new _if_tier() reduces a job's if: to an && chain of whole terms; only !cancelled(), needs.verified.outputs.run=='' and (for release) inputs.tier=='release' are accepted, anything else gives a problems row naming the job ('its condition ... cannot be proved to run on every run') and tier 'unproved' so its slices are not counted as per-run; jobs with no verify.sh call (the push-only verified guard) are not judged; the missing-slice message no longer says 'only the release tier does' for an unproved job; new case sv12 (sv0 allow case still green). (3) ci-verified.py: VOUCHING_EVENTS = workflow_dispatch, push; decide() refuses other events with a why naming the event; ask_github fetches jobs only for runs that can be accepted; docstring updated; _run fixture carries event; new case cv18 (cv1 still verifies). (4) check-git-pipeline.py (4 sites) and test_gen_demo_manifest.py (2 sites) now name verify.sh's e2e and manifests slices, read off sh tools/verify.sh --list; grep -n ci.yml of those two files finds no hit.
